title: Compactness of Conformal Metrics with \(L^p\)-Bounded \(Q\)-Curvature on Closed Smooth Riemannian Manifolds
summary: Let \((M^n,g)\) be a smooth closed Riemannian manifold of dimension \(n \ge 5\) with positive Yamabe invariant and semi-positive \(Q\)-curvature.
